_comment: Stage 0 sweep baseline — captured BEFORE any reconstruction work, on the unmodified repo.
Procedure: dev server on 8744, load each part's index.html, inject _test/xapi-720-j.js via
then `await window.__sweep()`. The stub is injected AFTER load rather than via ?xapiLib because
?xapiLib does not exist until Stage 2 — until then a hard localhost guard in each main.js
returns before the library ever loads, so window.sendStatement720 is undefined and every
xapiSend() is swallowed by its own try/catch. Injecting post-load gives the handlers a sender.
__sweep() calls __reset() first, so boot-time statements are excluded by design and only what
goTo() emits is measured. That is the invariant a pure move must preserve.
GATE for Stage 2: re-running this procedure must reproduce `visited` and `statements` exactly.
Stage 3 is EXPECTED to add item-level initialized/completed once XAPI_USING_G turns true.

methodica-science-volume-solid-01-03._note: Part 03 declares neither TOTAL_SCREENS nor goTo(). It is a single-screen part that never navigates, so this is inert today — but the shared goTo() reads TOTAL_SCREENS, so Stage 2 must add `var TOTAL_SCREENS = 1;`. Expect this fault to DISAPPEAR at Stage 2; that is the one intended deviation from this baseline.

methodica-science-volume-solid-01-05._note: DEFECT, not desired behaviour. Merely NAVIGATING onto screen 5 reports a component 'completed' — and reports the assessment as PASSED (success:true, hardcoded) with scaled:0, for a learner who answered nothing. The send sits inside resetScreenState(5), which goTo() calls on every entry. Fixed in Stage 4 by moving it to a synchronous peakFinish() driven by peakContinue().

methodica-science-volume-solid-01-06._note: DEFECT. Part 06 sends the component 'completed' from BOTH end screens (s5 pass, s6 fail), so one navigation pass emits it twice — the duplicate the ledger exists to prevent, reproduced here before any change. Same resetScreenState() cause as part 05.

confirmedLive: D6 — parts 05/06 emit component 'completed' from resetScreenState(), so it repeats on every entry. Part 06 emits two per sweep. Part 05 additionally hardcodes success:true.
D1 — zero item-level statements anywhere: the sweep produces no initialized/completed per item, because the loaded library letter (-f) is not matched by the XAPI_USING_G regex.
D7 — the localhost guard leaves window.sendStatement720 undefined on a dev server, so nothing is observable locally without this harness.
Part 03 declares neither goTo() nor TOTAL_SCREENS.
newInThisPass: The sweep oracle MUST be async. Parts 05/06 send through xapiSend() = setTimeout(…,0), so a synchronous read of the log reports zero statements for exactly the screens most likely to over-report. Found by the oracle lying about part 05. Same deferral that defeats the resume stub (risk R1).

Part 01 line 924 sends verb 'experienced', which is NOT in the 720 v2.4 verb list and has no VERB_IRIS entry. Severity is low, not fatal: the library falls back to 'http://adlnet.gov/expapi/verbs/' + verb, which for 'experienced' happens to be a real ADL verb, so the statement is valid — just off-spec. Stage 4 judgement call: the item-level initialized/completed pair from xapiOnScreen() already records that the learner engaged the comic item, so this is probably redundant rather than merely off-spec.
